decided: With neither setting turned on, each workflow that writes to a change makes one extra read-only check at its end, which reports that committing is off; the workflow then prints nothing and does nothing more.
alternatives: show the two settings in the change's status report, which the end of some workflows already reads, so no extra check is made; that would change a third part of orbit and still leave three workflows needing a check of their own
why: G0 allows workflow text whose effect depends on a setting when, with every setting at its default, what the AI does is unchanged; a read-only check that reports off and leads to nothing is the same kind of addition the chain's end-of-workflow status read already is.
